verdict.rationale: Gmail is a SaaS email service, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party MCP server. The Gmail REST API, push notifications, IMAP/SMTP and Workspace add-ons are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations, not an official MCP server for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
